_README: A LOCATION POLICY: where a candidate can work. Both location gates read it:
location-core.mjs (the scanner) and scripts/eval-prep.py (evaluation packets), plus the
triage, sweep and board tools through scripts/_location.py.
home_state: the state a state-scoped remote offer must name ('US, CA, Remote').
commute: places inside the commute ceiling; onsite or hybrid there passes. A missing
city is a silent discard, so err long. Matched case-insensitively on word boundaries.
same_state_out: metros in YOUR state that are outside the commute (for California, the
Bay Area). They veto an otherwise-passing onsite or remote-flagged option.
hard_out_metro: other metros that are out for onsite work, and that narrow a
metro-scoped remote offer out of range. Both gates read it.
To add a location, copy california-socal.json, which is the worked example.
name: remote-us
description: Remote anywhere in the US, no commute area. setup.mjs replaces home_state with yours so state-scoped remote offers can be judged.
